threads.body: [Style] Keep this helper private: the only call site is `copySupplier()` in this class, so exposing it publicly is broader than necessary.

replies.body:
Addressed in 9f4af17574efcf4cb4443d6594a45fbe3a1b2eb4.

Analysis: CouchbaseRequestInfo.copy is an implementation detail used only by copySupplier. Private visibility is sufficient and follows the repository's least-access rule.

Upsides: The class exposes only the supplier API needed by callers and prevents direct use of an internal copy helper.

Downsides: No material downside identified.

threads.body: [Style] Static factory entry points should be placed below the fields and immediately above the constructors, rather than after the construction section.

replies.body:
Addressed in cd19736646b3995a261a19c3161fba9085e60181.

Analysis: TracedOnSubscribe exposes perSubscription as a static construction entry point. Moving it directly below the fields groups it with the constructors and follows the repository's class organization rule.

Upsides: Readers can find every construction entry point in one section, and the class now matches the repository style guide.

Downsides: No material downside identified.
